title: Nadine & Gwen
description: Nadine and Gwen have been a couple for 6 months and live together. Nadine wants to propose to Gwen and copies the data from her phone to organize the perfect proposal. She discovers that Gwen ut

questions.question: I can't wait to ask Gwen to marry me! Can you check if she has anything planned on August 1, 2026, in the evening?
questions.hint: Open the Fitness app and look in next week's schedule. See what's planned in the evening in 7 days.

questions.question: Oh yeah, that's right she has her workouts... What time does she finish?
questions.hint: In the Fitness app, check the duration of the workout scheduled in 7 days. The end time is calculated by adding the duration to the start time.

questions.question: Great! I need to book a restaurant, can you tell me what her favorite type of food is?
questions.hint: Open the photo gallery and explore the different albums. Look for an album that might contain clues about her culinary preferences.

questions.question: Ew I hate that. But well, if it makes her happy, let's go! I think she had spotted a nice Japanese place, can you find their phone number?
questions.hint: Start with Notes to find a list of restaurants. Then search the phone contacts for the Japanese restaurant mentioned in the note.

questions.question: Perfect, they reserved us a table. You know what, I should really make this special. I think she had also seen some nice rings online. Can you give me the URL of her last open tab?
questions.hint: First look in Notes for a code to access private browsing. The note containing the codes is called 'Codes'. Once you find the right code, open Safari and access private browsing to see the hidden tabs.

questions.question: Sorry? I don't know that jewelry store, what kind of site is it?
questions.hint: Open Gmail and check the deleted emails. Look for a newsletter that might reveal the nature of the Her site.

questions.question: Maybe it's just an old registration... We've only been together for 6 months. Can you tell me when this registration was made?
questions.hint: Open Wallet and look in the transaction history. Find the payment to Her to see when the registration was made.

questions.question: I can't believe it, she's making a fool of me! Has she been talking to other girls since she signed up? If so, how many?
questions.hint: Explore the messaging apps: SMS, WhatsApp and Instagram. Look for conversations that start the same way, with an introduction mentioning Her. Count the total number of people contacted.

questions.question: I'm floored! Did she spend the night with one of them? If so, where?
questions.hint: Start with Instagram and look at the conversation with @Ju_defruit. Look for a booking mention with a specific date. Then open Airbnb and check the travel history on that date.

questions.question: She really hides her game well... I thought she was at the apartment while I was working. Do you have any info on this particular girl? What's her job?
questions.hint: Go on Instagram to find the full name of @Ju_defruit on her profile. Then search for this person on LinkedIn to discover her current job.

questions.question: No way... Did Gwen pay her for a service or something else? For what reason?
questions.hint: Go back to Wallet and look for a significant transfer to a company linked to Martel. The transfer description contains the answer.

questions.question: $1500 for a new beginning? She's emptying her savings lol... What was that Juliette's last message?
answer: I'm going to capture every moment of your pleasure
questions.hint: Open LinkedIn and go to messaging. Look for the conversation with Juliette Martel and read her last message from 3 days ago.

questions.question: She films when they... Shocked. And this Zoé, what's her connection to all this? What's her job?
questions.hint: Go on Instagram and look for Zoé's profile. Her job is indicated in her bio.

questions.question: And the other girl she talked to, Lorna. What does she do for a living?
questions.hint: Go to the Phone app and look for the contact file corresponding to this number.

questions.question: It's getting more and more unclear to me... What's their connection to each other?
questions.hint: First go to the phone contacts to find Lorna and Zoé's last names. Then search in Gmail, in sent emails, for a message to the bank mentioning these names.

questions.question: I feel like I'm completely off track... Why did she go through a dating site to contact them?
questions.hint: Start with ChatGPT and look for a conversation about number sequences where Gwen asks for a code. Use this code to access the hidden photo gallery and find a photo of a journal with handwritten notes.

questions.question: Wow OK! So I ruined her surprise... But I'm relieved to know she's not cheating on me. What day will her proposal be? So I know if I should cancel mine.
questions.hint: Go back to the photo gallery and look for a recent photo of the office. Zoom in on the details to find a post-it with a time indication.

questions.question: I'm the worst person in the world for doubting her. What exact time has she planned to surprise me on July 30, 2026? I'm going to take the evening off.
questions.hint: Open Calendar and look 5 days ahead for an event that might be hiding something else. Check the event description to discover the real plan.

textSuccess: I feel like I'm completely off the mark... Why did she go through a dating site to contact them? Wow OK! So I ruined her surprise... But I'm relieved to know she's not cheating on me. I'm the worst person in the world for doubting her. Thanks for your help, I'm going to cancel my reservation and act like nothing happened. I can't wait to see what she's prepared!

onboardingContent.text: Hey... You don't know me but I really need help. My name is Nadine and I'm in a horrible situation.
I've been with Gwen for 6 months. We live together in Portland and everything seemed perfect... I was even going to ask her to marry me.
But I found stuff on her phone... She's talking to other women on dating sites. I don't understand anything anymore.
I still have access to her phone. Help me understand what's really going on. Is she cheating on me or is there something else?

messages.text: Hey, it's Gwen from Her, wanna call?
Oh hey Gwen! Yeah I remember your profile
What do you do for work again?
I'm an interior decorator! And you play violin right?
Yeah exactly! Mainly for private events
weddings, birthdays that kind of stuff
Oh that's cool! Must be a nice atmosphere
Yes I love it! Though sometimes it's pretty stressful
especially weddings, everyone wants it to be perfect
I can imagine! With decorating it's the same, the bride always has very specific ideas 😅
Haha exactly! By the way where do you live in SF?
Mission District! And you?
Castro! Not far at all then
Perfect! We could meet for coffee one of these days?
I'd love to! Do you know the Blue Bottle on Valencia?
Yes very well! Tomorrow afternoon work for you?
Perfect! Around 3pm?
Great! See you tomorrow then 😊
hey! sorry I'm running a bit late
I'll be there in 10 min
No worries! I'm already here, I got us a table
Thanks! I have a red sweater on so you'll see me easily
That was really nice this afternoon! Thanks for the coffee 😊
My pleasure! I loved our conversations
Let's do it again soon?
Absolutely! Next time it's my treat
Deal! 😘
Hey! What are you up to this weekend?
babe what time are you coming home tonight?
around 7pm normally
why?
I feel like cooking together
it's been a long time since we did that
oh yes good idea! what do you want to make?
pasta carbonara?
I already have eggs and parmesan
perfect! I'll pick up some pancetta on my way home
and white wine?
yes! and grab some bread too
ok chef! 😘
I'm on my way
I have everything we need
cool! I already put the water on to boil
and I opened the wine 😏
haha you're starting without me!
just to taste 😇
I'll be there in 5 min
perfect timing! the pasta is almost ready
hey! did you see the new project they gave us?
the Pacific Heights one?
yeah! it's huge
4 floors to completely redo
I can't wait to start! the budget looks substantial
want us to divide up the floors?
good idea! I'd love to take the main living room
and the kitchen
ok! I'll take the bedrooms and master bathroom
deal! should we brainstorm tomorrow?
perfect! around 10?
Hey Gwen! Don't forget our session tomorrow at 7
oh thanks for the reminder!
I had completely forgotten
Haha I knew it! We're working legs tomorrow
ouch... my poor legs
you'll survive! 💪
cousinnnn! it's been way too long
I miss you
oh my Jess! I miss you too
how's it going in Oakland?
it's good! work is eating me up a bit
but otherwise it's fine
and you? how's Nadine?
she's doing great! still in her studio
we need to see each other soon!
yes! this weekend?
we could do brunch in Berkeley
excellent idea! Sunday works?
perfect! can't wait to see you
me too! 💕
Hi Gwen! There's a package for you in the lobby
I told the delivery guy to leave it there
Oh thank you so much Elena!
I'm going down to get it
No problem! By the way, do you know if they're going to fix the elevator soon?
it's starting to be a long time
no idea! I haven't heard from the building manager
I'll send them an email
Good idea! Keep me posted
Gwen! I saw your latest project on Insta
it's gorgeous!
oh thanks Maya! that makes me happy
the client was thrilled
I bet! The color mix is perfect
and how are you doing? still at Morrison & Associates?
Yes still there! But I'm thinking about going freelance soon
oh that's great! you should
if you need any advice don't hesitate
Thanks! I'll probably reach out to you 😊
Hey Gwen! Your usual latte is ready 😊
perfect! I'll be there in 2 min
By the way, we got the new beans from Ethiopia
want to try them?
would love to! always up for discovering new ones
Cool! I'll prepare you a sample
yo Gwen! do you remember prof Martinez?
graphic design? of course!
why?
I ran into him today at Union Square
he asked about you
ah that's sweet! is he doing well?
yeah he looks good
still at Berkeley
nice to hear about him
and how are you doing?
doing good! work work
but it's going well
cool! want to grab drinks soon?
would love to! I'll let you know this week
Your Sushi Zen order is on its way! Delivery expected in 25 minutes.
Your driver Carlos has arrived! Meet him in front of your building.
Hey Gwen! Are you coming to Thursday's quiz?
hey Tyler! what time is it again?
8pm! Party theme: 90s
perfect! I'm gonna be in my element
I'm coming with Nadine
Cool! Can't wait to see if you're as good as you claim 😏
you'll see! we're gonna crush you guys
haha we'll see! See you Thursday
Alert: Payment of $89.50 made at Blue Bottle Coffee on 26/04/2026 at 15:30. If this wasn't you, contact us at 1-800-BANKBOA.
Hey, it's Gwen from Her, shall we call each other?
Oh yes! The decorator! Hi Gwen ☺️
You seemed passionate about your work, that's cool
Thanks! And what do you do for a living?
I work in events, I organize weddings mostly
Oh that's amazing! You must see some beautiful stories
Yes exactly! Actually I have a big project right now
I'm organizing weddings for the same weekend 😅
Wow that's intense! Are you going to manage?
I hope so! Luckily I have a great team
Including an incredible violinist, Lorna
She plays like an angel I swear
I'd love to hear her!
If you want I can give you her number: +1 415 555 0126
She also does private concerts
That's so nice of you thanks! I might call her
You're welcome! By the way, are you free this weekend?
Sunday yes why?
Could we meet up? Grab a coffee?
I'd love to! Do you know a nice place?
Yes there's Blue Bottle Coffee near Union Square
Perfect! How about 3pm Sunday?
Hey! How's it going?
Hi Sarah! I'm doing well, how about you?
Great! Did you see the new client project?
Which one?
The loft in SOMA, they want modern Scandinavian
Oh yeah! I love that style
Could we team up on it?
Absolutely! Talk about it Monday?
Perfect! See you Monday then
Gwen ! Long time no see
Marcus! How are you doing?
Great! I'm passing through SF next week
Cool! You coming for work?
Yeah client meeting Tuesday
Could we meet up? Catch up on old times
Would love to! Tuesday evening work for you?
Perfect! I'll send you my hotel address later
Ok! Can't wait to see you
Me too! We're gonna have a blast
You remember our college nights? 😄
Haha how could I forget! We were crazy
Now we're responsible adults 😂
Yeah right... responsible, we'll see about that Tuesday 😜
Hi Gwen! Sorry about the noise last night
Oh no don't worry! I didn't hear anything
Good! My brother was visiting
He seemed to be having a good time 😅
Haha that's cool! By the way did you get my package?
Yes! It's in front of your door
Thank you so much! You're an angel
No problem! By the way, do you know a good plumber?
My sink is acting up
I can give you my guy's number
He's super professional and cheap
Oh perfect! Can you send it to me?
Joe Martinez : +1 415 555 0199
Hey Gwen! Ready for tomorrow?
Hi David! Yes but I'm scared 😅
Haha why?
Last time I was sore for a week
Normal! That means we worked hard
Tomorrow we'll take it easier I promise
Ok I trust you!
You can bring your girlfriend if she wants
I'll ask her! She likes cardio
Perfect! See you tomorrow then
See you tomorrow! 💪
Cousin! How are you doing?
Jess! I'm doing great, how about you?
Awesome! Tell me, are you still coming to the barbecue on Sunday?
Of course! Can I bring something?
A salad would be perfect
Ok! Quinoa salad work for you?
Perfect! Mom will be there too
Cool! It's been forever since I've seen her
She can't wait to see you! She talks about you all the time
Aww that's sweet! I can't wait either
By the way, is Nadine coming too?
I'll ask her! She loves barbecues
Great! The more the merrier
Exactly! See you Sunday then
See you Sunday! Kisses 😘
Hey! Maya gave me your number
Hey Alex! Yeah she told me
You're looking for a photographer right?
Yes for my portfolio! Maya says you're super talented
She's exaggerating 😅 but thanks!
Can you send me your portfolio?
Sure! I'll send you the link by email
Perfect! My email is gwen.costa@gmail.com
Noted! I'll send you that tonight
Great thanks! Should we do a call this week to talk?
Would love to! Thursday afternoon work?
Perfect! See you Thursday then
Gwen! How are you doing?
Maya! I'm doing well thanks! And you?
Great! I saw your latest projects on Insta, they're gorgeous!
Thanks! You do beautiful work too
By the way, I gave your number to Alex Thompson
The photographer?
Yes! Weren't you looking for someone for your portfolio?
Yes! Thank you so much!
He's really talented, you'll see
I can't wait to see his work!
You'll tell me what you think!
Hello Gwen! Your usual coffee is ready
Perfect! I'll be there in 5 minutes
Great! It's nice and hot 😊
Gwen! Guess what!
What?! 😃
I got an exhibition at Berkeley!
OMG that's amazing! Congratulations!
Thanks! Will you come to the opening?
Obviously! When is it?
August 3! I'll send you the invitation
I can't wait to see your works exhibited!
You'll see, I've come a long way since Berkeley 😄
I don't doubt it! You were already incredible
Hello Gwen, reminder of your appointment tomorrow 2pm for the scaling
Thanks! I'll be there

imagePath.imageDescription: Rectangular platter of nigiri and maki on black ceramic plate: salmon, tuna, avocado-cucumber maki, ginger and wasabi. Japanese restaurant ambiance, wooden table. Only sushi bar type assortments, no garnished rice bowl. No text or logo.
Top view: round plate garnished only with nigiri and sliced maki, sushi bar style presentation. Light ceramic, natural light. No garnished rice bowl — only sushi. No text.

messages.content: Hey Gwen! I have a small living room in San Francisco and I'd like to make it cozier without repainting everything. Do you have any simple ideas?

Great idea! Here are 5 simple ideas to make your living room cozier without repainting:
- Warm textiles: curtains, cushions and soft rugs.
- Neutral palette with a touch of soft color (powder blue, sage green).
- Varied lighting: warm floor lamp + dimmable LED string lights.
- Plants for life and texture.
- Define the space with a small rug for comfort.
Hey Gwen, what places do you recommend for sushi lunch near the Mission district?

Great idea! Here are my favorites near the Mission district:
- An intimate omakase for a personalized experience.
- A quick sushi-burrito spot near Market Street for lunch on the go.
- A relaxed kaiten-zushi where you can try several varieties without breaking the bank.
I have a studio and I'd like some quick tips to optimize storage without sacrificing style.

Here are some quick tips to optimize your studio without sacrificing style:
- Use multifunctional furniture (bed with storage, ottoman with storage space).
- Install wall shelves to free up floor space and display decorative items.
- Store things with matching bins and baskets, visible but organized.
- Go for a neutral palette with touches of color to energize the whole space.
- A well-placed mirror visually enlarges the space.
What's a quick routine to stay in shape in the morning without equipment?

Here's an express routine (about 20 minutes) without equipment:
- 3 rounds: 15 squats, 12 push-ups (modified on knees), 30 seconds plank.
- 2 rounds: 12 lunges per leg, 12 mountain climbers, 1 minute of fast marching in place.
- Dynamic stretches and deep breathing at the end. 💪
Stay hydrated and let's go!
For my kitchen, what trendy colors are easy to match?

For a modern kitchen that's easy to coordinate:
- Go for a neutral base (cream, light gray) and a deep accent (navy blue, olive green).
- Natural materials (light wood, stone) for warmth and durability.
- Black metal or steel for handles and lighting.
- Add a touch of texture with subway tile or a zellige backsplash.
Hi! I need a 6-digit code to lock my hidden photo gallery. Do you have any idea for an easy-to-remember combination?

Sure! 😊 Here's a suggestion for an easy-to-remember 6-digit code:

**341289**

It's a sequence of numbers that alternates between small and large numbers, which makes it easier to memorize than a totally random sequence.

A few tips to remember it:
- 3-4 → ascending sequence
- 12 → like the months of the year
- 89 → end of the 80s

Let me know if you want me to suggest others! 🔒
I'd like to set up a little plant corner in the living room, any advice?

Great idea! For a plant corner:
- Choose 3 to 5 easy-care varieties (pothos, sansevieria, pilea) to start with.
- Use wall shelves or a coffee table with built-in storage space.
- Vary the heights and textures of the pots for a dynamic look.
- Place them near a natural light source and consider light automatic watering if possible.
How to discuss with Juliette about a timeline and budget without tension?

Good question! Here's how to approach the situation:
- Present the deliverable and desired timeline clearly.
- Ask for a written and broken-down estimate (materials, labor, contingencies).
- Propose 2 schedule options and ask for regular check-in points.
- Stay open to dialogue and suggest concrete compromises if needed. 😊
How to choose lighting for a home office?

Good question! A few rules:
- Go for 3000–4000K for neutral and productive light.
- Mix ambient lighting and directional lighting on the desk.
- Choose dimmable LED bulbs and a lampshade that diffuses light well.
- Think about avoiding reflections on the screen and calibrating the lighting according to the time of day.
How can I make my decor more sustainable?

Great initiative! Here are 5 tips:
- Go for recycled or sustainably certified materials.
- Focus on quality and repair rather than replace.
- Choose accent pieces that work in different spaces.
- Go for upcycling and simple DIY projects.
- Choose brands that are transparent about ethics and the environment.
How do you manage your day between decorating and sports?

Good question! I apply the time blocking principle:
- Dedicated decorating blocks for client projects in the morning or late afternoon.
- Dedicated sports blocks (morning or lunch break) to stay in shape 💪.
- Stay flexible and leave room for unexpected things, while prioritizing your health and creativity.
How does your style reflect in your projects?

Oh wow, that's a whole universe! In summary:
- I love rich textures and subtle contrasts.
- Neutral palette with bold touches in accessories.
- Mix of modern furniture and vintage pieces for a cosmopolitan look.
- Focus on scale and harmony of spaces.

safariTabs.content:
# HER — Dating and Community for LGBTQ+ Women

![community](https://imgcaller.3t.net.vn/MobileDetective/v1/_external/images.unsplash.com/photo-1573496359142-b8d87734a5a2_463bc4ca.jpg)

## Welcome to HER

The world's largest free dating app for LGBTQ+ women, trans and non-binary people.

---

## Features

### 💕 Dating
- Swipe to match with women
- Chat with your matches
- Find relationships that matter to you

### 🌈 Community
- Join LGBTQ+ events near you
- Meet people who share your values
- Share your experiences

### 🛡️ Safe Space
- Verified community for women only
- Reporting and blocking
- A platform that cares about privacy

---

## Getting Started

**Download the app** or **sign up online**

✨ *"Finally a dating app made by us, for us"*

---

### Recent Activity
- Over 15 million women worldwide
- Available in more than 55 countries
- Featured in The New York Times, Vogue, Elle

### Safety First
- Mandatory photo verification
- Community guidelines enforced
- Support available 24/7

---
